为什么说"食物网"比"食物链"更能解释生态系统为什么稳？

Why does a "food web" explain ecosystem stability better than a "food chain"?

真实世界里物种有多条取食路径，一条断了还能走别的；网络越密，系统抗冲击能力越强，单一链条则脆得像一根线。
Real species have multiple feeding paths, so one break still leaves alternatives; denser webs resist shocks better, while a single chain is fragile as a thread.

食物链为什么会"越往上越轻"——能量金字塔是什么？

Why does a food chain get "lighter" upward—what is the energy pyramid?

每升一级，约九成能量以热和代谢散失，只剩一成左右传给下一级；所以顶层捕食者总量必然远少于底层植物，呈现底宽顶尖的金字塔。
At each step about 90% of energy is lost as heat and metabolism, leaving ~10% for the next level; top predators are thus far fewer than base plants—a bottom-wide, top-narrow pyramid.

为什么"外来捕食者"常比"本地捕食者"破坏更大？

Why do "alien predators" often cause more damage than native ones?

本地猎物没时间演化出应对新捕食者的办法，而外来者可能更高效、没有天敌制衡；于是猎物被快速清空，本地食物网随之紊乱。
Native prey had no time to evolve defenses, and the newcomer may be efficient with no local enemy to check it; prey are quickly wiped out and the native web unravels.

为什么去掉一个顶级捕食者，整条食物链可能"塌"掉？

Why can removing one top predator collapse a whole food chain?

顶级捕食者压制食草动物数量，一旦消失，食草者暴涨啃光植物、连带动摇整条链；这种自上而下的"级联效应"常被低估。
Top predators cap herbivore numbers; remove them and herbivores explode, strip plants and shake the whole web—a top-down cascade often underestimated.

为什么"少吃一环"会让下一环数量暴涨（比如狼—鹿—草）？

Why does "removing one link" make the next link boom (e.g., wolf-deer-grass)?

狼少了鹿就多，鹿多了草就被啃光；捕食者像"刹车"，一旦松开，下游就会失控式增长，这正是食物链相互牵制的体现。
Fewer wolves means more deer, which overgraze grass; predators are the "brake," and releasing it lets the lower link surge—showing how food chains constrain each other.
